title: Computing $A$-resultants via direct images
summary: We improve a previously known theoretic method to compute A-resultants for suitable monomial support sets due to Weyman to the extent that it becomes computationally feasible and effective. This is achieved by introducing a new algorithm for the computation of direct images of complexes of coherent sheaves on toric varieties. The procedure does not rely on Gröbner basis computations at any stage.
